Hello Mr. Ibrahim,

We have double-checked the availability, and unfortunately, the unit is no longer available for an extension.

Since we did not receive your confirmation or approval after the previous rate was shared, the unit remained available on our booking platforms and has since been reserved by another guest.

Therefore, we regret to inform you that we are unable to extend your stay in the same unit.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding.
